There are two issues with a crush sleeve. The first is that if you go too far and have a too much preload when setting things up you will have to throw away the crush sleeve and start over. The second is that if you ever have to loosen the pinion nut, you have to replace the crush sleeve and set preload. If you never have to replace your pinion yoke either to upgrade or replace a broken yoke it may never be an issue.

Installing this takes a bit more effort than a crush sleeve but once it’s set it won’t change even if you pull the pinion yoke and install a new one. That piece of mind to me is worth the very small amount of extra effort.
